name: billing_format_money
notes: Money display formatter — whole dollars render with no decimals, fractional always 2dp. C port (billing_view.c::billing_format_money) traced + LIVE Python twin (agent/billing_view.py::format_money). Cup-parity across 13 representative amounts. KNOWN LIMITATION (documented, not a logic bug): sub-cent exact-half values like 0.005 cannot be represented as a C double, so the formatter (which takes `double`) diverges from LIVE's exact Decimal there (printf rounds 0.005->$0.01 vs Decimal ROUND_HALF_EVEN->$0.00). All representable money values match. Fixing requires the C API to accept a scaled-integer or string (Decimal) — a caller-affecting change deferred from this gate-expansion task.
